text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Bouquet-san! Are you 
having some trouble?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...No, um... A fan gave me some flowers, 
but I'm troubled over where to put them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
These flowers bloom for a very long time. 
I'd love to display them somewhere they 
can bring comfort not just to me, but to 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm, gotcha~. In that case!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And so! I'd like to set up a new flower 
bed somewhere at the academy! Would you 
give me permission?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! An offer from a student to improve 
the academy! That's more than I could ever 
ask for!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Approved! I look forward to the flower 
bed that will soothe everyone's hearts! 
Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! The work itself isn't hard, but 
making a flowerbed is way tougher than I 
thought! I'm like 20 miles worth of tired!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If we're going to make something 
authentic, it might take a bit of time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even so…… we should prepare a flowerbed 
worthy of the flowers we were given, 
shouldn't we?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: After all, they bloomed so beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, you're right! All right, at 
times like this...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Um. I've come to help, for whatever 
it's worth.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Thanks for coming, both of you!! 
Thanks 200 miles!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. For dragging everyone into 
my personal request.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Bouquet-chan. Don't say things like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You take care of me all the time, after 
all. Let me help you out for once ♡"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Is it... finished for now, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right. ...Mm. Isn't this 
looking pretty good?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: “......Yes. You're right, with this......”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for helping out today. Now all 
that's left is to put flowers here—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Let's speak from the heart, Bouquet-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Wait... Gran-san?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to be completely convinced, 
Bouquet-san. —That's how I feel. That's 
why..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Let's talk this out, properly!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Gran-chan is absolutely right. 
So, you see? Don't hold back, 
Bouquet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much, everyone. Now, 
um... I'm terribly sorry to impose, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I want to be closer to the flowers. 
That's the kind of flower bed I'm aiming 
for...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Just a little longer. Would you mind 
keeping me company for a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed behind the school 
building, I saw a flowerbed filled with 
beautiful blooms.
choice_data_list: Huh? Was there a flower here?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufun~♪ As expected of my Trainer. Good 
catch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, this flowerbed— Bouquet-san, 
the others, and I worked super hard to 
plant it together!"
choice_data_list: Wait, is that how it is!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help letting out a gasp of 
surprise. Because the flowerbed they had 
built was an authentic brick-crafted 
structure—
choice_data_list:
That must have taken a lot of strength, 
huh?

Everyone worked patiently together to make 
this!

Everyone worked patiently together to make 
this, didn't they!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help letting out a gasp of 
surprise. Because the flowerbed they had 
built was an authentic brick-crafted 
structure—
choice_data_list:
That must have taken a lot of strength, 
huh?

Everyone worked patiently together to make 
this!

Everyone worked patiently together to make 
this, didn't they!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hauling dirt, carrying bricks... It 
really wasn't a big deal at all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because it's me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it was great muscle training! 
—Look! All buff now☆
choice_data_list: Fufu. Looks like it might be working.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Next time we make a flowerbed, I'll 
make an even more— like, a 100 miles more 
amazing one, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We had a thorough discussion! About how to 
make things even better!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because we were able to have a discussion 
like that— we made something everyone is 
happy with!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I was able to convey my thoughts 
properly. Ehehe..."
